sentence: Deactivate a staff member in Mega-Net EHR Cloud.
You need the Org Admin role.
You will choose the person, choose Deactivate, and confirm.
Open the menu, and choose Staff Directory.
If the list is long, type part of the person's name in the filter box.
Choose the row of the person you want to deactivate.
Their details load into the form below.
Choose Deactivate.
The app asks you to confirm.
If you choose Cancel, nothing changes.
Choose OK to go ahead.
A message confirms it, and the person's status changes to Deactivated.
Deactivating removes their access to this organization.
Nothing is deleted.
The person stays in the list.
A deactivated person who tries to log in with that role is refused.
Deactivate works only after you choose a person.
You cannot deactivate your own record.
The screen tells you so if you try.
To recap: choose the person, choose Deactivate, and confirm.
That is how you deactivate a staff member.
